quote.text: Oh, dear me!" he lamented. "The raft has floated off and I suppose it's gone down that awful hole by now." "Well, never mind. We're not on it," said Snufkin gaily. "What's a kettle here or there when you're out looking for a comet!
quote.author: Tove Jansson
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Embrace life’s little mishaps as teaching moments for your children—when a small setback occurs, see it as an opportunity to cultivate resilience and adaptability.
    • Just as Snufkin remains untroubled by the drifting raft, guide your loved ones to appreciate that not every loss warrants sorrow; instead, encourage them to explore new horizons with curiosity and joy.
  • Leadership:
    • As a leader, accept that things beyond your control can change unexpectedly—focus on what remains in your sphere of influence rather than lament lost opportunities.
    • Adopt an expansive vision; like the pursuit of a distant comet, inspire others to look beyond minor setbacks and strive toward bold, transformative goals.
  • Product Management:
    • In product development, projects and ideas may drift off course, but like Snufkin’s lighthearted remark, learn to detach from trivial misses and remain open to unexpected opportunities.
    • Focus on the bigger picture—prioritize visionary goals that encourage innovation and healthy risk-taking rather than dwelling solely on small operational setbacks.
